balance_clamp.topology: S=local BATN; D=ETA EN; G=local BATP through 100k pull-up; optocoupler pulls gate low

FET_RELEASE.driver: U_SEQ SN74LVC74A Q1 / FET_RELEASE (single output net)

working_boundary_readback.do_not_change: three high-voltage NPN devices are outside scope

two_gate_initial_current_estimate.note: rough resistor-limited initial current; TI SN74LVC74A VOH is guaranteed at 100µA and specified at other discrete currents; no directly matching transient VOH guarantee for this two-branch charge event

paper_estimates_not_guarantees.charge_qualification: Qg values are specified at VGS=4.5V, above the approximately 2.762V static logic-drive floor; do not use them to claim an exact charge time at 2.762V.
paper_estimates_not_guarantees.balance_gate_cross_threshold_estimate: With 100k pull-up and AO Ciss table values, approximate tau=82..105us; this is a comparative RC estimate, not guaranteed switching time. ETA3000D2I p2 lists T_ALLOW=3.85ms typ, T_CHECK=7.68ms typ and T_SLEEP=2s typ. The 2s sleep interval is not a guaranteed initial startup blanking time. Neither the typical checking timers nor this RC estimate prove first-cell insertion transient safety.
paper_estimates_not_guarantees.default_state: The settled FET_RELEASE default remains gate-low through each 100k gate-source pulldown; larger gate capacitance changes only edge/power-loss decay timing. Balance EN clamps still have 100k BATP pull-up and optocoupler pull-down; a brief EN rise during initial ramp is not ruled out by this paper estimate.
paper_estimates_not_guarantees.claim_boundary: Ciss values are at different VDS points (AO 15V, BSS 10V); BSS Ciss has no min/max limits shown; these RC values are comparative estimates only, not guaranteed maximum switching/off time or full-temperature result.
